publicationDateEvidence.author: NotifyMe
publicationDateEvidence.dateDerivation: Discord snowflake milliseconds = (message_id >> 22) + 1420070400000. The archived local display is September 5; the UTC live event is September 4.

mechanisms.finding: The official Global launch dungeon explanation allows parties with players of the opposite faction and different servers.
My Faction Only is an optional checkbox for restricting dungeon groups to the player's faction.

limits: Dungeon grouping is the verified scope; ordinary shared-world questing and cross-region parties are not established by this segment.
The caption at 3662 seconds reads four dungeons for spoken for dungeons; do not turn this into a dungeon-count fact.
The October 4 web open was throttled. Existing complete official transcript and oEmbed archives were reviewed; successful fresh playback is not claimed.
